stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import deque, Counter
def components(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=1; cells=[]; c=g[i][j]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+di,b+dj
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==c:
                            seen[x][y]=1; q.append((x,y))
                res.append((c,tuple(sorted(cells))))
    return res
def norm(cells):
    pts=sorted(cells)
    ra=min(a for a,b in pts); ca=min(b for a,b in pts)
    return tuple(sorted((a-ra,b-ca) for a,b in pts))

def components(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if not seen[r][c] and g[r][c]!=bg:
                col=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=set()
                while st:
                    q=st.pop(); cells.add(q)
                    for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        rr,cc=q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc
                        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and not seen[rr][cc] and g[rr][cc]==col:
                            seen[rr][cc]=True; st.append((rr,cc))
                out.append((int(col),frozenset(cells)))
    return out
